structure: Kentucky Academic Standards for Social Studies (Dec 2022). Front matter (TOC, introduction, legal basis, vision, organization, inquiry-practice and discipline-strand definitions, coding explanation) precedes grade sections. K-5 and 6-8 band overviews each have a Grade-level Introductions page. Each grade K-8 has three parts: (1) '<Grade>: <Theme>' title + 'Specific Overview' (introduction, key vocabulary, looking back/ahead, 'What this would look like in practice' table with Standard / Sample Evidence of Learning columns, Opportunities for Cross-Disciplinary Connections); (2) '<Grade>: <Theme> Standards' with an Introduction paragraph and a 'Concepts and Practices | Standards' table whose first column names the practice/concept (I: Questioning, I: Investigating, I: Using Evidence, I: Communicating Conclusions; C: / E: / G: / H: strand concepts such as Civic and Political Institutions (CP), Microeconomics (MI), Migration and Movement (MM), Change and Continuity (CH), Kentucky strands KGO/KE/KGE/KH) and whose standards column holds codes of the form <grade>.<strand>.<concept>.<n> (e.g. K.C.CP.1, 4.G.MM.1, 8.H.CO.4; inquiry codes <grade>.I.Q/UE/CC.<n>); (3) '<Grade>: Disciplinary Clarifications and Instructional Support' with Civics/Economics/Geography/History strand tables (Concepts and Practices | Standard | Disciplinary Clarifications) that repeat each standard beside its clarification. Inquiry standards are repeated per grade (no separate K-12 shared block in this range). High school sections and Appendix A progressions fall after this range (from u2355). Labeling choices: grade title headings and the Concepts-and-Practices standards tables = standards; introductions, Specific Overview material, sample-evidence tables and clarification tables (including the standard text copied into them) = examples; explanatory sentence under each clarifications heading = backup.
